title: Data Engineer
text:
Data Engineer - Example Logistics Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru
3 to 6 years

What you will do
- Build batch data pipelines in Python and SQL
- Process large files with PySpark on Databricks
- Schedule jobs with Apache Airflow
- Model tables in Snowflake for the analytics team
- Move data from our apps with Azure Data Factory

Must have
- Python, SQL
- Spark (PySpark)
- Airflow
- ETL design
- Snowflake or BigQuery

Good to have
- dbt
- Kafka
- AWS

Hybrid. Notice period up to 45 days.
